end.summary:
Practised identifying thousands, hundreds, tens and ones places in 4-digit numbers.
Worked on reading and writing number names such as 2,345 and 8,614.
Diya identified place values in 2,348: 2 thousands, 3 hundreds and 4 tens.
Diya joined spoken number parts incorrectly and did not yet consistently separate tens and ones.
A short break was taken; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value and writing 4-digit numbers from number names. Diya correctly identified the thousands, hundreds and tens digits in 2,348, and used 40 + 2 to make 42; they then mixed up how a two-digit part such as 35 fits into tens and ones, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, practise building number names with four place-value cards, saying each digit’s place before writing the numeral.
